high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "mallikastomar." The post features a woman standing outdoors at night, leaning against a wooden railing with a lattice design. She has long, dark red hair and is wearing a black dress with a deep neckline and a high slit on one side. She accessorizes with a necklace and carries a small, dark-colored handbag with a chain strap. Her pose is confident, with one arm raised to her head and the other resting on the railing.
